title: More than a platform.
subtitle: You're choosing who you'll work with as the technology under your mission evolves. Here's why 1,200+ nonprofits trust DonorDock.

narrative.title: Built from day one for nonprofits
paragraphs: DonorDock was founded in 2017 by two Microsoft engineers who wanted to build something genuinely useful for nonprofits in their community — not an enterprise CRM with a nonprofit skin, but a platform purpose-built for how fundraising teams actually work.
Everything in DonorDock was built by our team from the ground up. No acquired tools taped together. That's why the platform feels coherent — because it is.

quote.text: You're not just buying a tool. You're really partnering with an organization. Especially with how fast technology is changing — what matters is what the partnership looks like over the long haul.
